narration:1:1320618001:0.text:
Removing the top of the heavy coffin, a smell of decay and dust rises to the surface.
The body in the coffin is incomplete. The left hand and left leg are missing. It's a horrible sight to behold.
However, the movement of the coffin seems to have disturbed the creatures in the temple.
narration:1:1320618001:0.source_cn: 移开沉重的石棺顶盖，一股腐朽冷寂的气息伴随尘土扑面而来...
